plugins.name: learn-repo
plugins.description: Turn findings about a codebase into interactive HTML learning pages: C4 architecture, data flow, data model, module dependencies and process swimlanes.

plugins.name: context-handoff
plugins.description: Hands work off to a fresh Claude Code session through a written brief, and prompts the handoff once context reaches 80%. Relies on the agterm terminal app (agterm.com) to open the new session; without it, prints the steps to start it by hand.
